premises.text: A significant portion of customers do not spend to their maximum potential at local businesses
premises.evidence_span: 15% of their customers, people like me, represent about 50% of their revenue

premises.text: Traditional loyalty programs are inconvenient for customers
premises.evidence_span: But that's a pain for me to manage as a customer. I hate carrying them around.

premises.text: Existing mobile loyalty solutions require too much effort from customers
premises.evidence_span: they all suffer the same problem. A lot of work for me as the customer.

premises.text: Current loyalty solutions are not personalized for customers
premises.evidence_span: none of these solutions are personalized for me.

premises.text: Cardify allows customers to earn rewards effortlessly through their existing payment methods
premises.evidence_span: I get points at these local places by simply swiping my credit card.

premises.text: Cardify provides businesses with real-time insights about their customers
premises.evidence_span: we show the business's real-time insights into how Cardify impacts their bottom line.

premises.text: Cardify can help businesses recognize customers based on their spending history
premises.evidence_span: we actually surface up a ton of data about those people.

premises.text: Partnerships can expand Cardify's reach to a large number of merchants
premises.evidence_span: Cardify has a partnership with Citigrid Media and with Urban Spoon, which gets us to about half a million merchants across the U.S.

value.text: Customers receive personalized rewards and recognition at local businesses
value.evidence_span: custom-tailored towards you based on how much you spend, what you're interested in, and who you are.
